_comment: Hand-curated gating summaries per v1.4 changed detector. Consumed by tools/discover_versioned_detectors.py to populate gating_summary field in v14_changed_detectors.json. Keys are the literal `detector=` value emitted by each finding (which is what regression assertion `detector_filter` matches); for findings emitted by private helpers (e.g. `_make_ex_001`), the key is the public detector name baked into the helper.
validate_voltage_levels: datasheet-gated on rated voltage vs rail voltage (VM-001)
validate_crystal_load_caps: new in v1.4, requires CrystalBlock dataclass (XT-001)
validate_feedback_stability: datasheet-gated on regulator load step + bandwidth (FS-001)
detect_absolute_max_violations: new in v1.4, requires operating_max field (AM-001)
detect_vcc_outside_recommended: new in v1.4, datasheet-gated recommended operating range (OV-001)
detect_5v_on_non_tolerant_pin: new in v1.4, pin-level 5V tolerance check (FT-001)
detect_wrong_signal_type: new in v1.4, multi-function pin conflict detection (PM-001)
detect_missing_required_components: new in v1.4, required-component lookup via _make_ex_001 helper (EX-001)
